string-array.name: release_notes
string-array.item: Search finds folders as well as files, listed under the Files tab with the folder they\'re in underneath. Tapping one opens it in the Files app; if no app can show it, its path is copied so you can find it yourself.
\"Reduce index size\" also leaves out the folders it skips files in, and WhatsApp\'s many weekly voice and video note folders.
Typing an app\'s name also lists a few of its shortcuts right under it, the ones you use most first, so \"clock\" finds \"Create new alarm\" too.
A new About page in settings shows the version you have and what\'s new in it.
